tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas dus tha ma'i cho ga bya tshul 'khor 'das dge legs 'bar ba'i 'od can zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho skyed dang sbyor ba'i yum// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol ba'i lha// skal ldan mkha' spyod khrid pa'i lam bstan ma// bla ma rdo rje btsun mos dge legs stsol// zab las ches zab rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bcud// mkha' spyod btsun mo'i man ngag la brten nas// sbyin sreg cho ga'i lag len 'dir bshad kyi// don gnyer can dag dad dang spro bas longs// de nas 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud la brten nas/ 'phags bod kyi skyes chen rnams bde mchog la brten nas dus tha ma'i cho ga mdzad pa gzhir bzhag ste/ de nyid yum la sbyor ba'i lugs kyi lag len bya ba la don gsum ste/ lho sgo la brten nas sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ ro bsreg ste sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ mchod rten byas te sbyang ba'o// dang po la'ang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ste 'dir bsdus pa'i dbang du byas nas/ ji ltar 'os pa'i gnas su rang nyid kyi mdun stegs kyi steng du bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa kha rgyan mgul chings nang rdzas/ rdor gzungs dang bcas pa'i mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa/ rdor dril nang mchod ḍā ma ru rnams bshams/ gser dngul snag tsha mtshal sogs kyis yum gyi rtsa sngags

yum gyi rkang brgyad kyang bri/ snying po badz+ra bai ro tsa na sogs/ nye snying sham bu can shog bu la bcad pa ma yin par re re'i mtha' la sngags so so'i mjug rdzogs par bris pa'i rtsa sngags snying po/ nye snying oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs gsum gyi steng thad la 'bru gsum so sor bris pa dang*/ yum gyi go cha'i sngags so so la dri bzang gis byug pa'i gdags yig dang*/ sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa'i gdags yig nyer bzhi btags kyang 'gal ba med cing*/ de dag sbyor ba'i rdzas sbrang bu ram cung zad re yang bsdu bar bya'o// de nas gnas yo byin rlabs nas brtsams te bsam mi khyab rdzogs nas go cha'i bsrung ba'i bar gyi bdag bskyed bsgoms la/ bum pa/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bum pa zhes sogs 'dra ba las/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma ro'i steng du khaṇ+ḍa ro hi sku mdog dmar skya g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon mi dang bcas pa'i thod pa bsnams pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hi la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya se gol gyi sgra dang bcas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ bdag bskyed ltar 'khyud rgya sngags dang bcas lan gsum bya/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re sogs nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā sogs nas re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i/ shab+da pra tits+tsha bar/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/

rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba song bas bum nang gi lha la phog pas ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta/ brgya rtsa'i rjes gong ltar mchod bstod byas nas he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ pad kor dang bcas pas dung chos kyi chu phul la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ de nas ro de nyid la zhi ba/ zhi drag phyed ma/ drag po'i sbyong ba rnams bya dgos pa ni/ 'chi khar bar chad byed pa'i gegs de ro la gnas pa'ang srid pas de skrod pa'i ched yin zhing*/ ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med/ de nas rten byin rlabs can la khrus gsol ba'i khu ba dang bcas pa'i bum pa'i chus rgyas par na phar phyin drug gi tshigs bcad dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka ta spel zhing bkru ba'am/ yang na khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka ta kho na bzla bzhin pas legs par bkrus pas chog go /bkrus zin pa dang*/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi bzla bzhin pas gur gum la sogs pa dri bzang zhim po'i chus ro der byugs la rtsa sngags dang hūm̐ brjod cing snying gar snying po dang āḥbarjod cing mgrin par/ nye snying dang oṃ brjod cing dpral bar so so'i thad kyi sha la btag yig rnams sbrang bu ram gyis sbyar ba'am/ bsgril nas so sor btags pa'am/ ro ras sogs kyis sgril ba'i phyi thad la btags kyang rung zhing*/ lte ba snying ga sogs bsgom bya'i gnas so sor yang yig 'bru rnams gdag pa dang*/ sbyong rgyud kyi gdag yig nyer bzhi yod tshe de dag kyang gnas so sor btags la phyag len shes pas ro legs par bsgang zhing ras sogs kyis bsgril te stegs kyi steng du rang la kha phyogs par bzhag pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/

bsnyen pa dngos la 'jug pa'i tshe mchog dman gyi dbye bas ro mchod gnas ltar sbyong ba dang*/ sbyin bdag ltar sbyong ba gnyis su byed na/ dang po la ro/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las waṃ las chu yi dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ badz+rī bha wa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma gyen du yar lud pa las rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bai ro tsa na ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ mtshan sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ rten gyi thugs kha'i bh+rūm̐ la phog de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang gi snying gar thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna la mchod pa'i sprin phung sprul te/

rten lha yi rang bzhin la mchod pa phul bas mnyes par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ dmigs pa brtan pas ro'i snying gar gzungs thag btags pa nas bzung ste/ oṃ gsum ma ci mang bzlas pa'i rjes su/ slar yang mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus la go cha'i srung ba nas bkra shis kyi bar bya/ de ltar zhag bdun la sogs pa'i bzlas pas kha gso'i bsnyen pa tshang bar byed nas/ thun bzhi la sogs par bcad nas thun re re bzhin bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ lhar bskyed pa rnams tshang bar bya'o// de tsam ma grub na thun rer bzlas pa ma nyung tsam zhig dmigs pa kho na brtan pos bya'o// gnyis pa ro sbyin bdag ltar sbyong ba ni/ gzhan khyad par med la/ ro de lhar mi bskyed par de'i spyi bor rnam snang sngar bzhin bskyed pa las bzlas pa'i dmigs pa rnam snang gi thugs ka'i bh+rūm̐ las 'od zer byung ste 'og gi chu dkyil la phog pas ye shes rang bzhin zag med kyi chu rgyun du byon/ rus pa'i spyi bo nas babs pas sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag par bsams la sngags bzla'o// gnyis pa lho sgo dngos kyis sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ spyir rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi sin dkyil du gshin por dbang bskur pa mi rung mod kyang*/ lho sgo bya bar 'gal ba med cing phan thogs chen po 'byung bas de ji srid bar bya ba'i tshul la/ dkyil 'khor gyi chas yongs rdzogs dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ ras sogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa de'i lte bar nṛ'am/ yang na gshin po'i gzugs brnyan rdzus skyes kyi tshul thal mo sbyar ba/ pad+ma la pus btsugs su gnas pa'i steng du 'dug pa/ g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan ba dan gyis mdzes pa'i gzugs brnyan bris pa'i rgyab tu/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu song ba dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba da nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sdig pa sbyong du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bris la rus bu'am/ gos dri ma can nam/ yang na 'jim pa la btsug ste dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su bzhag pa'i mdun du sbyong chas dkyus bzhin rus bu dang bcas te bshams/ gzhan yang*/ yungs kar/ gu gul/ me long sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du byas la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzung tshes bcu'i yig cha gzhan rnams ltar na bdag 'jug rdzogs pa'i bar dang*/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa ltar na brgyud 'debs gnyis rdzogs pa'i bar byas la/ dmigs rten bum chus sbyangs/ sbyong chas chu gtsang gis bran la/ dmigs pa brtan pos rten sum+bhas bsangs/ shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su sbyong stegs pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad khru gang pa'i dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar nṛ yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i phung khams skye mched rnams yongs su rdzogs par gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ dang tshe 'das kyi snying kha'i nṛ las 'od zer 'phros pas dmigs yul gyi rnam shes gang na yod kyang skad cig la bkug par gyur/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum/

skye gnas bzhi/ rigs drug srid pa bar do gang na gnas kyang skad cig la 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod la dmigs pa ni/ rten de la gshin po'i rnam shes bstim ste/ mngon sum lta bur gyur par bsam/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdam pa las gung mo dang mtha' bzhi bsgreng ba sdig pa bral ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha na sarba pā paṃ a pa na ye hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bita sarba pa paṃ bhi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bita tra tha/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi s+pho ṭa ya sarba a pa bhan+dha ni pra mo k+ṣa ya/ sarba a pa ya ga ti bh+ya sarba sa twā nāṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya tra tha/ zhes lan gsum/ rdo rje bsdam pa'i phyag rgya bcing bkrol yang yang bya zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra bhan+dha tra tha/ zhes mang du brjod/ rdo rje khu tshur/ snying kha lkog ma kha phyogs dang*// dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis// mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis// sna dang rkang pa pus mo bol// long bu sna yi rtse mo dang*// mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas// zhes pa'i gnas rnams su gtug pa'i stangs ka bya zhing*/ oṃ sarba bita badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med pa gcig tu gyur/ de nas zhi ba/ zhi drag phyed ma/ khro bo spyan 'dren sngon 'gro'i drag po'i sbyang ba rnams 'dra ba las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bden bdar gong bzhin la/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa dang*/ slar yang gshin po de nyid kyi cha byad du byas te nye 'brel dang 'jig rten pa gzhan rnams bslu bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs gang yin pa de dag thams cad rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyong ba sogs 'dra/

de ltar lan gsum byas pa'i rjes su rten gyi mdun du til g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bzhag la/ tshe las 'das pa zhes bgyi ba'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams/ yi ge kaṃ gi rnam par byung nas mdun gyi til la thim/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pa paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swā hā/ las kyi rdo rjes lag g.yas kyis g.yas dang*/ g.yon gyis g.yon/ gnyis kas g.yas su bskor la me dang chur dor ba lan gsum/ me chur blug la phyir 'phang zhing*/ dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa che ge'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas sa'am/ til lam/ yungs kar gang yang rung ba la shes na bde mchog yab yum gyi rtsa sngags gnyis med/ snying po gnyis med/ nye snying gnyis med rnams dang*/ snying po sbyor ba bzhi/ thugs gsung sku'i lha/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ go cha gnyis med rnams dang*/ khyad par oṃ gsum ma tshar gang mang*/ gzhan yang yig brgya/ durga/ kaṃ ka ni rnams bzlas pa'i ha 'debs pa'am/ yang na oṃ gsum ma sogs rang gi gang shes kyi gzungs sngags byin rlabs can mang du bzlas pa'i has btab la rten la brab cing*/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ga te he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ga te he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ga te he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes dang yig brgya dang*/ kaṃ ka ni bzlas pas lan gsum brabs la/ dmigs yul 'di zhes bya ba'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad brabs pa'i sgo nas byang zhing dag par gyur cig ces brjod/ mchod g.yog pas sku phyis phrag pa g.yon la bkal/ me long bum pa 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor la sku khrus gsol zhing*/ gzhan rnams kyis rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i gsung la 'gags pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i gsung la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs la 'khrul pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// sogs/ de dag sku la sogs/ rten khrus byas pa'i chu bum par blugs nas/ rten gyi gzugs brnyan me long du shar ba la pha rol phyin drug gi tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ gsum ma spel zhing khrus byas pa'i mthar/ tshe las 'das pa'i che ge mo zhes bgyi bas gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dag nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig zhes brjod/ yang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// sogs kyi tshigs bcad oṃ gsum ma dang spel ba'i mthar/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa/ sogs nas/ nyon mongs la dug gsum gyi rnam rtog bcom nas dge ba phun sum tshogs pa ldan par gyur cig sa 'di dug gi pha yin te// sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ gsum ma dang spel ba'i mthar/ tshe las 'das pa/ sogs nas/ sems can thams cad kyi 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas skyes pa'i rnam rtog rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad 'byung bzhi'i chos nyid kyi ngang du thim nas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig zhes brjod/ bum chu dang me tog 'thor zhing*/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// sogs kyi mthar/

tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i thog drangs skye dgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas/ 'o 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa che ge mo khyod rang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi gnas 'di nyid sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor 'di dang tha mi dad pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa ni rten gyi stobs/ de'i spyan sngar khyed rang gi pha mas gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag po bskyed pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang sdig pa'i las mi bgyid snyam pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ de ltar bgyis pas sdig sgrib ji ltar byas kyang 'dag nges snyam pa sor chud pa'i stobs te/ stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags pa bgyi'o snyam pas lus gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal/ ngag gus pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro'i rjes zlos gyis/ yid gus pa'i sgo nas dad mos kyis shugs drag po dang ldan pas phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pa mdzod la/ bu la sogs pa'i nye du yod na ming byang yod na bzung nas phyag byed du bcug la/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// sogs nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// sogs bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi phyag 'tshal dang*/ ston pa bla med sogs/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs/ dag pas 'dod chags sogs/ grol nas grol ba'i sogs/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sogs/ 'jam dbyangs phyag na sogs/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs/ gtso bo rgyal ba sogs kyi mthar/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung*/ sogs gong rgyab yig skabs bzhin brjod/ de nas rten/

sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dmigs yul 'di zhes bgyi ba sangs rgyas rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bzung ba'i dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ nas/ shab+da'i bar/ mthar ḍā dril rol chen/ rdo rje dpag med sogs kyis bstod/ tshogs la sogs pa'i 'dod yon chab kyis bran la/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// rnam shes rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig tshe 'das byang chub myur thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa ka ma gu ṇa sogs/ gzhan rnams la'ang des rigs 'gres shes par byas nas bsngos pa'i mthar/ tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba'i mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes pa/ rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan pa/ sna'i yul du dri zhim pa/ lce yi yul du ro bro ba/ lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam pa la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la ma chags shing ma zhen pa'i ngang nas longs spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod/ lam sbyang bstan bya ba ni rdor dril 'dzin cing me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ tshogs lam smig rgyu lta bu ste// gnyis pa du ba lta bu yin// gsum pa glog tu khyod kyis mthong*// bzhi pa mar me lta bu yin// lnga pa thams cad stong pa yin// sangs rgyas sa nyid thams cad de// srid pa bar do 'di nyid du// khyod kyi lam lnga mthar phyin shog /ces pas lam sbyangs nas/ lam bstan pa ni/ khyod kyi lam lnga mthar phyin pa'i// phung po lnga ni sangs rgyas lnga// nyon mongs lnga ni mkha' 'gro lnga// rnam shes brgyad ni ye shes lnga// 'byung ba bzhi ni lha mo bzhi// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas// chos kyi 'khor lo yongs bskor te// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur// zhes brjod/

de nas dmigs yul gyi don du smon lam gang shes bgyis pa'i mthar/ gtor bsngo nas mjug chog gi bar dkyil chog bzhin bya'o// gal te zhag bdun phrag gsum dang bdun la sogs pa byed na'ang bdun phrag re re song ba dang sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol byas nas gsar pa bshams/ ming byang bsreg tshe nub tha ma la bsreg pa yin pas/ de'i tshul ni/ lam sbyangs bstan gong du bya ba'i mtshams der byas te/ nub snga ma rnams ni tshe 'das lhar gsal ba la mchod bstod byas pa'i mjug tu lam sbyangs bstan bya ba yin la/ nub tha ma'i tshe mchod bstod byas nas ming byang bsreg ste lam sbyangs bstan byed pa yin no// de bsreg pa'i tshe slob dpon gyi lag tu dpal 'bar dang ming byang bzung*/ snying rje chen pos/ 'o tshe las 'das pa che ge mo khyod nyon cig 'di ltar gzugs la sogs par yod par snang ba'i chos thams cad dang*/ bdag gzhan gyi tshor ba bde sdug gi 'du shes la sogs pa thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa la bden pa bzung ste don la med bzhin du 'khrul snang gis bsdus pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong dgos pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje dung pa re sgom mdzod/ de ltar stong nyid snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas khyed rang gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib da lta bar do'i 'khrul snang phyi ma ngan song gsum du skye 'gyur gyi las ngan ji snyed yod pa thams cad blos phyogs gcig tu bsdoms te bsreg bya bud shing gi rnam par gyur/ skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi thugs rje dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga rnam par dag pa'i nus mthu/ nye du 'brel pa shul na mchis pa rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang*/ khyed rang gi shes rgyud kyi steng na yod pa'i dge rtsa thams cad blos phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas sreg byed ye shes kyi me'i rnam par gcig tu gyur/

me de nyid kyis bsreg bya sdig pa'i bud shing sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad bsreg bya sreg byed dang bral ba'i tshul gyis bsregs pas khyed rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo skye ba med pa rdo rje chos su gnas pa de nyid 'di nas skar mda' 'phang ba bzhin du mkha' la spyod pa'i zhing khams su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs 'bring du 'khod de/ de yang gsal stong 'dzin pas ma bcings pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu// phung po lnga yi bud shing la// rgyal ba lnga yi me spar ro// nyon mongs lnga yi bud shing la// mkha' 'gro lnga yi me spar ro// rnam shes brgyad kyi bud shing la// ye shes lnga yi me spar ro// zhes dang*/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing bsreg la sāts+tsha gdab bo// 'di dag ni gang zag tha mal pa la bya ba'i dbang du byas la/ mchog rnams la ni sbyong stegs kyi steng du thog ma nas sangs rgyas rdo rje chos bskyed pa la thugs dgug gzhug byas la/ sdig pa bral ba'i sngags rnams dor nas bgegs sbyong ba dang sdig pa sbyong ba rnams byas la rten khrus grub rjes slar yang rten der rten khrus zhig byas la mchod bstod 'bul tsam khyad par ro// de rnams kyi rnam shes dgug gzhug ni/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes zhing khams gang na bzhugs kyang skad cig la 'dir mchis par gyur/ zhes dang*/ bgegs sbyong ba'i tshe dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las la bar du gcod par byed pa zhes sbyar/ de rnams kyi lho sgo la brten nas sdig pa sbyong tshul rnams ma tshang ba med par bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa ro bsreg ste sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ sngar bdun tshig tshar ba yin na mi dgos mod/ ma byas pa'i rten yin na rten bkru ba dang*/ gdag yig sogs bya dgos pas de la thog mar gnas yo byin rlabs nas go cha'i bsrung ba'i bar byas la/

de nas las bum gong du bshad pa bzhin bsgrubs/ chu des rus bu bkru tshul/ rten rnam snang ngam/ rten gyi spyi bor rnam snang bskyed pa skabs sbyar/ gzungs thag btags nas bsnyen pa/ bskyed pa mdor bsdus mchod bstod bya ba rnams gong bdun tshigs kyi thog mar bkod pa bzhin byas rjes/ rten tha mal pa dang mchog gi dbye bas gson po'i rnam pa dang*/ lha'i rnam pa ci rigs par bskyed nas rnam shes dgug gzhug sogs cho ga rnams rim bzhin bya'o// sreg chog dngos la 'jug pa ni/ thog mar thab bya ba'i sa phyogs su gnas gsar pa yin na sa chog bsdus pa byas la phyag dar dang zhal zhal legs par byas nas ba yi rnam lnga dang*/ dri bzang gi chus byugs/ theg chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ dbus nas khru gang bskor ba thab kyi tshad/ de'i phyi sor bzhi pa gnyis bskor ba kha khyer mu ran/ de la rdo rje'i phreng ba kha zum pas bskor ba bri/ de'i mthar gru bzhi'i thig btab la/ kha khyer sor bzhi byas pa'i nang gi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje kha zum pas mtshan par bris/ zlum skor nang ma'i nang nas lte ba'i bar gyi tshad de zlum skor dang shar nub gnyis kyis tshang thig 'dzom steng nas bzung shar nub g.yas g.yon du rtags byas la/ shar gyi tshangs thig zlum thig 'dzom steng nas lho nub dang nub byang du thig gdab/ lho nub kyi rtags steng nas nub byang du thig gdab/ de bzhin du nub kyi tshang zlum 'dzom steng nas shar lho dang*/ byang shar du gdab/ shar lho dang byang shar gyi rtags steng gdab chos 'byung bzhi 'byung ba bzhin/ de nang du sor gang tsam gyi thig btab pa chos 'byung gi re khā yin/ de la rdul tshon nam chu tshon gyis thab yongs rdzogs dkar po/ chos 'byung gi nang dmar/ re khā dkar/ mdun rgyab spang ba'i grwa bzhir dga' 'khyil dkar dmar g.yon skor dbus su tshon spung ngam gri gug bri'o// de'i steng du bsreg khang bya ste de'i dpangs su mtho gang nas sor bzhi thog rtsig pa thog phub/

de'i steng du bum pa/ de steng bre sogs byed/ bum pa'i nang du lus dang*/ bre nang du mgo bo yod par byed cing*/ bum par sreg rdzas 'bul ba'i sgo dang brer dud khung re yang bya/ de'i nang gi rgyab tu shing khru re tsam pa gnyis sam/ shin tu bzang ba gcig gis chog la/ mdun du shing bzang ba bskum khru re gnyis/ de'i steng du bya tshang zhes pa shing khra mo dang ras dmar gyis sbags pa/ de steng du rgyab kyi shing gi steng du rū pa'i 'phang mtshams dang*/ mdun gyi shing gi steng du rkang bzhag la ro de cung zad sgur ba byas la dbyibs myang 'das mchod rten lta bu ste/ shing brtsegs pa'i thad de gru bzhi rū pa bzhag pa'i thad dbyibs zlum po byas la/ so phag gi sreg khang brtsigs pa'i mdun du phyag len 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir me tshang byas la me sbar ba'i tshe thog mar rgyab phyogs nas sbar ba ltar ru'i khong nas sreg gang bzhag pa'i dgos pas mdun nas me 'jug cing*/ rū pa sgur bar bya ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ gzhan yang shing khang mthil yangs shing kha dog pa zhig byung na myur bar tshig cing bud shing byung bas chog par snang bas de ltar du bya'o// de rnams ni sbyor ba ste nyi ma gcig la grub par byas nas/ nyi ma gnyis pa la sbyin sreg dngos la 'jug pa'am/ sbrel nas byed pa gang ltar yang dngos gzhi cho ga la 'jug pa ni/ rang nyid kha shar du phyogs pa'i g.yon gyi g.yas su chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ 'das gtor dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dam rdzas lnga bdun gsum la sogs pa skong ba'i gtor ma rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar rang gi phyag len ltar dang*/ me lhar zlum gtor/ rang gi thab kyi g.yon du 'o ma can gyi shing lcang dkar la sogs pa gas grum med pa'i sbom phra mtheb chen nas mtheb chung gi bar la ring thung sor brgyad khru gang*/ sor bcu gnyis sogs kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i rtsa rtser mar sbags dri bzang byug pa/

mar khu/ til/ las kyis shi ba'i ba sha mar du rngos la btub cing bdud rtsi ril bu rgyab pa/ zho phye mar gsum sbrang bu ram rnams bsres pa'i zas mchog ku sha/ dūr+wa/ nas/ so ba/ gro/ 'bras/ sran ma/ dzā ti la sogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs/ til nas 'bru sna tshogs kyi bar zangs sder la sogs pa'i snod bzang por bkod nas bzhag pa dang*/ ku sha/ yam shing snod med par gzhi steng du bkod/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdor dril bar du dgang blug kha sbyar/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ 'thor nas/ gong gi las bum/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad spor lde/ me yol rnams mthong brgyud kyi phyag len bzhin bshams la/ gnas yo byin rlabs nas go cha'i bsrung ba'i bar gyi bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom la me btsal ba ni gong gi spor lde sbar ba thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung*/ gson cig dgongs shig sogs gong lho sgo'i nang bzhin gyi mthar thab la g.yas su bskor tshul lan gsum/ sum+bha brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing me sbar/ sngags de nyid dang*/ mar blugs gzar gsum gyis me gso/ bsang chu ni/ sngar gyi las bum des chog par byas la/ rang lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ sum+bha dang hūm̐ ring po brjod pas rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ sngags de nyid brjod cing ku sha'i 'thor g.yab kyis bsang la bgegs bsal/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu zad mi shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhi ba'i las 'grub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ di paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā/ oṃ aṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ yang thab la bsang chu gtor la/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po rgyar khru gang zabs su khru phyed/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan zhing phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas pa'i dbus su raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang po dbyu gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis par guṇ+ḍi 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan zhing*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pas stod g.yogs pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi ma hā bhū ta de wa ṛ ṣi dwi dza/ satwā ma gṛ hi to ma hā asmin+na hi to bha wa ag+na ye e h+ye hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ ag+na ye ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ag+na ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur bas// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo zhing rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// 'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa ā ma ma shīn+taṃ kur+wan+tu swā hā/ zhes brjod cing phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor du dgram/ dgang blugs byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung la/ me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ dgang blugs kyi kha la'ang raṃ gyis mtshan par bsam/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ gzar bu bdun gyis dgang blugs mar gyis bkang*/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pya ā dī pya ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ye dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/

bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'am/ yang phal pa la/ dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya bas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag sogs gong bzhin sbyar te gong ltar byon zan lan gsum phul skabs der me pra brtag la/ ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chu gtor/ dgang blugs kha sbyar thab la lan gsum bskor/ de nas gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la sreg rdzas lan gsum 'bul ba ni rdzas rnams g.yon pas rim bzhin bzung*/ g.yas pas mtheb srin gyi steng nas blangs/ cung zad bskor zhing mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas 'bul ba'i yam shing la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la dz+wā la ya bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum 'bul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ zhes pa'am/ dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa/ sogs gong bzhin skabs sbyar gyi spel tshig sbyar/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang shes par byas la/ mar la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ ba sha bdud rtsi ril bu dang bcas pa la/ oṃ ma dwa na bā la pañtsa a mṛ ta swā hā/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de ye swā hā/ ku sha la/ oṃ badz+ra a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ dūr+wa la/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ nas la/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye swā hā/ gro la/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ra ye swā hā/ so ba la/ oṃ badz+ra bī dza ye swā hā/ 'bras la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ dza ti la sogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs la/ oṃ ma hā shrī pha la war+dhā ni swā hā/ zhes so so nas bdun re phul ba'i mthar spel tshig sbyar/ gong ltar mchod bstod byas la mar nag dgang blugs gang thab nang du blugs/ oṃ ag+ne dz+wā la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/

zhes brjod cing bsam pa ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ mchod gnas ltar sbyang ba dang*/ sbyin bdag ltar sbyang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mchod rdzas dang*/ bsreg rdzas kha gso/ gong bzhin byin brlabs byas la/ bsang chu dang*/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ zhes pa nas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar la/ de nas spos rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī e h+ye hi sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas gang zag de'i thugs dang dbyer med pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma spyan drangs la/ de nyid la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pā ri wā ra/ sngon du 'gro bas nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas phyi mchod/ mtshan sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ gong bzhin dgang gzar blugs bzung la/ oṃ ag+ne swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī ā dī pya dī pya dī shud+dhe ma hā shrā+e ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'am dmigs yul sogs gong bzhin gyi spel tshig sbyar bas byon zan lan gsum phul la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes mdun bskyed dang gnyis su med par bstim/ 'khyud rgya dang*/ go cha/ dbang bskur ba rnams mdun bskyed bzhin bya/ gong bzhin mchod bstod byas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ zhing gshegs pa dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī oṃ badz+rā dz+wā la dz+wā la bho dhi bṝk+ṣa/ sogs gong bzhin brgya rtsa la sogs pa phul ba'i mthar spel tshig sbyar/

rjes gzhan la'ang de bzhin du shes par byas la phul ba'i mthar gong bzhin sbyin sreg phul/ mchod pa kha gso la/ tshes bcu'i skabs bzhin mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ stong gsum ma dang*/ rig ma bcu drug rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga rnams kyi phyi mchod dang*/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs sngon 'gro'i nang mchod 'bul ba rnams rgyas pa bzhin/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi bstod pa sogs gang shes/ lam rim smon lam/ gtor bsngo/ bskang ba bstod pa sogs skabs sbyar so so'i phyag len bzhin byas la/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ sogs kyis bzod gsol/ thab nang gi lha la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can/ sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod cing g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thal ba cung zad blang la dpral mgrin snying ga rnams su thig le bya ba ni/ 'das pa'i me lha la bya ba'o// 'jig rten pa'i me lha lhag mas mchod pa ni/ mar dgang blugs gang thab nang du blug la/ oṃ dz+wā la raṃ/ me lha zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i skur gyur/ zhes brjod la yam shing nas 'bru sna tshogs kyi bar gyi sreg rdzas rnams gong ltar spel tshig dang bcas pas phul ba'i mthar sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya/ gtor ma sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ag+na ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ sogs mtshan sngags kyi mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas sngags lan gsum 'bul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ spro na/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba'i bstod pa rgyas pas kyang bstod/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ slar yang yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis bzod gsol/ rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/

med pa la gshegs gsol byas la go cha dang tshams rngam sngags kyi srung ba/ dag pa dran pa bsngo smon bkra shis rnams cho ga bzhin bya ba ni ro mchod gnas ltar sbyong ba'o// yang sbyin bdag ltar sbyong ba ni/ de'i tshul phal cher ni snga ma dang 'dra ba la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ro lhar mi bskyed pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad pa la ro de nyid sreg rdzas su 'bul ba yin pas/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i sreg rdzas rnams rdzogs mtshams/ de'i phung po yongs su rdzogs par mchod rdzas su dmigs nas thal mo sbyar la/ dmigs yul 'di zhes bya ba'i khrag ni mchod yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o// dri chu ni zhabs bsil du 'bul bar bgyi'o// nang khrol dang dbang po rnams ni me tog tu 'bul bar bgyi'o// dri chen ni bdug spos su 'bul bar bgyi'o// tshil chen ni snang gsal du 'bul bar bgyi'o// klad pa dang rgyus pa rnams ni byugs pas 'bul bar bgyi'o// sha dang rkang mar ni zhal zas su 'bul bar bgyi'o// rkang dang rus pa ni gling bu dang rgyan du 'bul bar bgyi'o// pags pa ni byang chub gyi yan lag bdun te bla re ru 'bul bar bgyi'o// rus pa gzhan rnams ni bden pa bzhi ste bud shing du 'bul bar bgyi'o// mgo dang*/ klad pa dang*/ snying dang*/ glo ba dang*/ rgyu ma dang*/ mchin pa dang*/ mtsher pa dang*/ mkhris pa dang*/ dri chu dang*/ lgang pa dang*/ g.yas g.yon gyi mkhal ma dang*/ rtsa dang*/ chu rgyus dang*/ zhag dang*/ grod pa dang*/ mnye ma dang*/ sha dang*/ khrag dang*/ khu ba dang*/ rkang mar dang*/ tshil bu rnams ni sreg rdzas su 'bul bar bgyi'o// skra dang sen mo dang ba spu la sogs pa ni gzhal yas khang gi rgyan dang spyan gzigs su 'bul bar bgyi'o// zhes phul ba'i rjes su lho sgo'i skabs ltar lam sbyangs bstan byas la/ 'das pa'i me lha la gong gi sbyin sreg 'bul ba nas bkra shis bar gong bzhin bya'o// cho ga gnyis ka la'ang me shi ba dang*/

rang nyid thab kyi drung du phyin nas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya se gol gyi sgra dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes yang yang dang*/ sum+bha dang yig brgya bzlas bzhin pas rus pa rnams bsdu ba ste/ de dag ni ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyangs pa'o// gsum pa mchod rten byas te sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ thog mar bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ las bum sgrub pa gong bzhin byas pa'i chus las bum gyi sngags dang yig brgya brjod pas rus bu legs par bkrus la zhib par btags te 'jim pa dang sbyar ba'i gong bu de nyid snod du bzhag pa'i mdun chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bshams la/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du skad cig gis sangs rgyas rdo rje chos zhes sogs lho sgo bzhin bskyed la/ bstod pa'i rjes su/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i phung por gyur/ de nas rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb chung mtheb mos mnan/ lhag ma gsum brkyang la gan rkyal du gnas pa'i khar 'jim pa bzhag g.yas de lta bu'i phyag rgyas/ kha sbub tu bkab la rnam snang 'od kyi rgyal po'i sngags sam/ yang na/ oṃ gsum ma gang mang bzlas pas byin gyis rlabs/ de nas/ oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐ āṃ dz+rīṃ khāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing 'jim pa blangs/ 'bi 'bi bya zhing snum byugs pa/ rgyar gzhug pa/ dbyung ba thams cad la sngags de nyid dang*/ rus pa la rten 'brel snying po dang*/ sum+bha brjod de legs par btab nas shog bu sogs la rten 'brel snying po sogs gzung sngags bzang po gang shong bris la gur gum gyis byug nas legs par dril/ na bza' dang bcas pas bzhugs su gsol/ zhabs sdom legs par byas nas stegs kyi steng du bzhag nas/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rnam snang he ru kar bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs bstim/ dbang bskur rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/

pañtsa ku la sogs mtshan sngags la chu gnyis nyer mchod sbyar bas mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs kyis bstod/ kun mkhyen ye shes/ sogs spyan dbye brtan bzhugs bkra shis mnga' gsol rnams bya ba ni rab gnas bsdus pa'i lugs yin la/ rgyas par shes pa rnams kyis ni de'i cho ga bzhin du bya'o// gong du bkod pa'i sāts+tsha btab grub nas bdag bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba rnams gzhung bzhin btang zin pa dang rab gnas la 'jug go /de dag gis mchod rten byas te sdig pa sbyang tshul bstan zin to// 'dir smras pa/ de ltar rdo rje btsun mo'i rnal 'byor la// brten pa'i dus mtha'i cho ga bya tshul 'di// tshig nyung don mang 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub byed yin// 'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyis// dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig kun byang gyur nas// tshe 'dir mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo yi// go 'phang 'grub nas bstan pa rgyas byed shog /ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas dus mtha' ma'i cho ga bya tshul 'khor 'das dge legs 'bar ba'i 'od can ces bya ba 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams dang*/ rje bla ma thar rtse grub pa'i dbang phyug gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa snyoms las mkhan sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis a ṇi kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi ma zhing gzhan du gshegs skabs pur sbyong dus mchod dang bstun rang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i kye rdor dus mtha'i cho ga don gnyis lhun grub dang*/ mkha' spyod ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam/ rmor chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i gshin po rjes 'dzin thar lam 'dren pa'i lcags kyu rnams la brten nas rang bzo'i dri ma dang bral bar dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog dam par sbyar ba 'di la gal srid nor 'khrul mchis na chos kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags pas zhus dag pa mdzad du gsol// shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dzā ga tāṃ//

༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sa chog nyung du bzhugs so// ༈ /swa sti/ mkha' spyod ma'i sa chog ni/ mchod rten gang du bya ba'i sa phyogs phyags dar byas pa'i dbus su/ mañdzi dang maṇ+ḍal gyi khar sa lha'i tshom bu/ de'i mthar shar lhor mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar nas bzung ste chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yon skor du gru bzhir bshams/ shar du sa lha dang phyogs skyong la zlum gtor gnyis/ gzhan yang rdor dril nang mchod spos yungs kar sogs 'dus byas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri zhes pa nas/ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ de nas lag pa g.yas pa'i srin lag sa la reg la/ rang gi srin lag g.yas pa'i rtsa bar ham̐ yig 'bar ba/ ham̐ ham̐ ham̐/ zhes brjod pas/ sa g.yos pa'i rkyen gyis tshom bu'i steng du sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis las ci bgyi bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes smra bar gyur/ mchod pa ni/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi gṛh+ṇa daṃ/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi mthar rol chen/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyang la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ gang ba'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs lan gsum gyis phul/

rdor dril spos 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seṅge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te thugs rten bzhengs// lan gsum gyi mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rten bzhengs par 'tshal nas phyogs 'di bdag la stsal zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod mchod rten gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i/ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul/ lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la reg nas/ badz+ra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid du thim par gyur/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ākar+ṣa ya dzaḥ o da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ phyogs skyong ba chen po khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ yang g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon snying gar sdig mdzub bcas/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs lan bdun gyis bgegs la ster ba'i gtor ma ni phyogs skyong gi de nyid do// g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub g.yon dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pa'i/

sa phyogs 'dir ni bdag cag rnams// bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten// bzhengs kyis 'di la gnas pa'i bgegs// 'di na ma 'dug 'gro bar gyis// lan gsum gyi mthar/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig yungs kar gyis brab cing gu gul gyis bdug de nas mchod gtor thams cad bsdus/ de'i shul du lag pa gnyis kha sbub tu reg la/ oṃ bhu kham oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la/ rang gnas su 'dug nas/ sa phyogs 'dir pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyi rol kun tu mda'i drwa ba dang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa ban dha hūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ wi ta na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tram̐ sam̐ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ga hūm̐ ram̐ hūm̐/ de rnams lan gsum gsum brjod/ de nas yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i sogs mjug chog dkyus bzhin no// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sa chog nyung ngu 'di ni a ṇi drung rdo rje btsun mo kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi ma'i dgongs rdzogs phyi rten khang bu brtsegs pa g.yu mkhar ma'i nye skor du bzhengs skabs sa skya pa kun blos sbyar ba 'di la sbyin sreg sogs kyi cho ga byed tshe tshig rnams blo gros go yangs kyis shes par bya'o//
